name: bearingkit
description: A protocol and skill set for AI-assisted software work: autonomy gate, evidence rules, spec, plan, build, test, review, ship and close workflows with independent review for hot paths.

interface.shortDescription: Disciplined delivery workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Bearingkit classifies every request (act or council), routes it to a skill, and holds the work to evidence: tests first, guardrails pasted, independent review on hot paths, a two-block handoff at the end of a session.
